competitiveTarget: Beat portal city-directory pages with a live regional pulse and a ledger of Central Oregon cities, not a link farm.
note: PUBLIC_UI.md §3 city grain (2026-08-14). First screen is doors to cities, not a number hero and not a house-stamp dump. Section order: Breadcrumb, Ledger (cities), Instrument (region pulse below the fold), Sheet (SFR alerts), Quiet (edges), Footer outside main. Chrome is layout-owned V3Chrome. Do not remount it. Capture: submitSearchAlertSignup with city empty and propertyType A, via RegionalAlertSheet (trap name company).

requiredComponents.name: KbSectionTracker
requiredComponents.section: tracking — section_view telemetry. pageType=index. Wiring, not visual language.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: structured data — breadcrumb schema; CollectionPage + ItemList rendered inline.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: breadcrumb — Home / Cities. JSON-LD is in MetadataBlock.

requiredComponents.name: V3Ledger
requiredComponents.section: city doors — the opening. Featured plus the rest of the index. Ledger media only when cityHero() is verified. Next tap is a named city.

requiredComponents.name: V3Instrument
requiredComponents.section: region pulse below the fold — live active count, median list, months of supply. marketVerdict classifies the raw MoS. Not the first screen.

requiredComponents.name: RegionalAlertSheet
requiredComponents.section: SFR listing-alert capture. Same action and filters as the retired RegionalSfrAlertsBand.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: edges — communities, housing market, search, valuation, Oregon Data Share.

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: footer outside main so the element is a contentinfo landmark.

requiredComponents.name: getRegionPulse
requiredComponents.section: Instrument — live region stats (active count, median list, months of supply).

requiredComponents.name: getMarketPulseCitySnapshots
requiredComponents.section: Ledger — live per-city active count and median.

requiredComponents.name: cityHero
requiredComponents.section: Ledger media — verified per-city photography only. Unverified cities get no photo.

requiredComponents.name: getCityContent
requiredComponents.section: Ledger detail — one sentence per featured city from hand-written content.

requiredComponents.name: listingsBrowsePath
requiredComponents.section: Ledger and Instrument ghost door into the live list.

layoutComponents.name: V3Chrome
layoutComponents.section: layout-owned public header. Pages must not remount it.
layoutComponents.note: Not in requiredComponents because the gate checks the route file. app/layout.tsx mounts it.
